en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ziyad Bin Ab Al Hallal who said,
‘I had dinner with Abu Abdullahasws so heasws said: ‘The dinner after the last Isha (Prayer) is the dinner of the Prophetsas’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ziyad ibn abu al-Hallal who has said the following:

“I once took dinner with abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and he said, ‘Dinner after ‘ Isha ’ al- Akhirah (time of late evening Salat (prayer)) is like the dinner of the prophets, ‘Alayhim al-Salam.”’
